entries.title: DRAFT RWRE directional escape posterior martingale
entries.statement: For a static nearest-neighbor RWRE and fixed nonzero l, define A_l={X_n dot l tends to +infinity}, q(omega)=P_0^omega(A_l), and tau_x omega(y,e)=omega(x+y,e). If F_n reveals the full environment and the first n steps, then q(tau_Xn omega)=P_0(A_l|F_n), converging almost surely and in L1 to 1_A_l. DRAFT deduction; independent review pending.

entries.title: DRAFT RWRE quenched positivity is weaker than zero-one
entries.statement: For stationary ergodic strictly elliptic static nearest-neighbor RWRE, p=P_0(A_l)>0 implies q(omega)=P_0^omega(A_l)>0 almost surely; p<1 implies q<1 almost surely. Thus a mixed p would have 0<q<1 almost surely. Positivity alone does not prove p=1: the zeros of q and 1-q propagate by harmonicity, while their values need not be translation invariant. DRAFT deduction; independent review pending.

entries.title: DRAFT incoming density of the environment seen from a RWRE
entries.statement: Let P be a translation-stationary law of static nearest-neighbor environments on Z^d, tau_x omega(y,e)=omega(x+y,e), and mu_n the annealed law of tau_Xn omega from 0. For every n>=0, d mu_n/dP=f_n, where f_n(omega)=sum_{|x|_1<=n} P_{-x}^omega(X_n=0); f_n>=0 and E_P f_n=1. The formula gives finite-time absolute continuity, not a stationary law or uniform integrability. DRAFT deduction; independent review pending.

entries.title: DRAFT mixed directional transience forces density concentration
entries.statement: In stationary ergodic strictly elliptic static nearest-neighbor RWRE let q=P_0^omega(A_l), p=E_P q, and f_n=d Law(tau_Xn omega)/dP. If 0<p<1, then B_epsilon={q<=epsilon or q>=1-epsilon} has b_epsilon=P(B_epsilon)->0 as epsilon decreases to zero, while a_n=integral_B_epsilon f_n dP->1. For r>1, E_P f_n^r>=a_n^r/b_epsilon^(r-1) whenever b_epsilon>0. Hence E_P f_n^r->infinity. No time-diverging subsequence of f_n or its Cesaro averages is uniformly integrable. DRAFT deduction; independent review pending.
assumptions: stationary ergodic strict-elliptic static nearest-neighbor RWRE

entries.title: DRAFT directional zero-one bridge from incoming-density uniform integrability
entries.statement: For stationary ergodic strictly elliptic static nearest-neighbor RWRE on Z^d, define f_n(omega)=sum_{|x|_1<=n}P_{-x}^omega(X_n=0) and F_N=(1/N)sum_{n<N}f_n. EXTRA ASSUMPTION: either {f_nj} or {F_Nj} is uniformly integrable for a deterministic sequence n_j or N_j tending to infinity. Then P_0(X_n dot l tends to +infinity) is zero or one for every fixed nonzero l. A uniform L^r bound, r>1, on that subsequence is sufficient. IID and strict positivity alone do not discharge the extra assumption in this packet. DRAFT conditional proof; independent review pending; C0044 remains unresolved here.
assumptions: subsequential uniform integrability of incoming densities or their Cesaro averages

entries.title: DRAFT refutation: normalized densities need not be uniformly integrable
entries.statement: On ([0,1],Lebesgue), g_m=m times indicator_[0,1/m] is a nonnegative probability density for each m. If m>K, its mass above K equals one, so the family is not uniformly integrable; integral g_m^r=m^(r-1) for r>1. Thus first-moment normalization and individual absolute continuity cannot justify a uniform integrability bridge. This family is not claimed to be an RWRE realization or a counterexample to C0044. DRAFT exact counterexample; independent review pending.

entries.title: DRAFT C0044 missing incoming-density bridge
entries.statement: C0044 asks for P_0(A_l) in {0,1} in a static iid strictly elliptic nearest-neighbor environment on Z^d, d>=3. The conditional incoming-density argument requires subsequential uniform integrability of f_n=sum_{|x|_1<=n}P_{-x}^omega(X_n=0), or its Cesaro averages. The elementary bound f_n=O(n^d) and E_P f_n=1 do not prove that condition. Shared sites and adaptive path selection prevent treating incoming probabilities as independent factors. Current openness is UNKNOWN because a September 23, 2026 primary preprint claims resolution but has not been independently checked in this packet. This is a gap record, not a theorem.
assumptions: static iid strictly elliptic nearest-neighbor RWRE
